title: When Does Learning Beat Heuristics? A Case Study in Kubernetes Scheduler Score Plugins
abstract: arXiv:2609.22142v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Kubernetes scheduler plugins that score candidate nodes are, in production, hand-tuned heuristics. We ask whether a learned scoring function - trained on real placement decisions from a production cluster trace - can match or exceed these heuristics, and if not, why. We implement an external, HTTP-backed scoring plugin for a widely used scheduler simulator and evaluate two learned models (a Random Forest over engineered features, and a graph neural network encoder over per-job task-dependency graphs) trained on a large-scale production cluster trace. Under standard regression fit (R^2), both models improve modestly but monotonically across four feature-engineering iterations, reaching R^2 of about 0.042. translated_title: 学习何时能胜过启发式方法？——以 Kubernetes 调度器评分插件为例的案例研究
translated_abstract: Kubernetes 调度器中对候选节点进行评分的插件，在生产环境中通常是手工调优的启发式方法。我们探究一个学习得到的评分函数——基于生产集群追踪数据中的真实放置决策进行训练——能否匹配或超越这些启发式方法；如果不能，原因何在。我们为一个广泛使用的调度器模拟器实现了一个外部的、基于 HTTP 的评分插件，并在大规模生产集群追踪数据上评估了两个学习模型（一个基于工程化特征的随机森林，以及一个针对每个作业任务依赖图的图神经网络编码器）。在标准回归拟合（R²）指标下，两个模型在四轮特征工程迭代中均取得了温和但单调的提升，R² 达到约 0.042。然而，在调度中真正重要的指标上——即 Top-1 排序准确率，也就是模型是否将生产调度器实际选择的机器评为最高分——两个学习模型均被一个简单的单特征（基线）所超越……
tldr: 该研究发现，在 Kubernetes 调度器节点评分任务中，基于生产集群数据训练的学习模型（随机森林与图神经网络）虽在回归拟合上有所提升，但在最关键的 Top-1 排序准确率上仍不敌简单的单特征启发式方法，说明学习型方法在何种条件下能超越启发式仍需谨慎评估。
en_tdlr: This case study shows that learned scoring models (Random Forest and GNN) for Kubernetes scheduler node scoring, despite modest regression improvements on production cluster traces, are outperformed by a trivial single-feature heuristic on the metric that matters most: Top-1 ranking accuracy.
